entry_points.name: close_account
entry_points.note: Registered through the ROUTES list in app.py, which imports the account module.

stores.name: users

fields.name: signup_ip
fields.note: The IP address recorded when the account was created.

fields.name: deleted_at
fields.note: The column close_account sets instead of removing the row; the purge job selects on it.

erasure.note: close_account writes deleted_at and commits; the Celery task purge_closed_accounts, scheduled daily in CELERYBEAT_SCHEDULE, deletes rows whose deleted_at is older than RETENTION_DAYS.

stores.note: The users table defined in models.py and created from that definition by db.py.

stores.name: uploads/avatars

fields.name: avatar_key
fields.note: The object key is built from the user id, so the key itself points at one person.

fields.name: original_filename
fields.note: The uploader's own file name is stored as S3 object metadata.

erasure.note: cleanup_user_files calls delete_object but no module in the repository calls cleanup_user_files, so the close_account docstring's promise to remove uploaded files is not carried out by any call.

stores.note: Avatar images written by upload_avatar under the avatars/ prefix of the uploads bucket.

stores.name: stripe.Customer

fields.name: name
fields.note: The user's full_name is sent as the customer name.

erasure.note: signup sends the email and full name to Stripe; the repository contains no call that deletes or redacts the Stripe customer.

stores.note: Stripe customer records created at signup through the stripe SDK.

stores.name: nightly_backup

fields.name: email
fields.note: Listed in DUMP_COLUMNS and read off each User row into the dump file.

fields.name: full_name
fields.note: Listed in DUMP_COLUMNS and read off each User row into the dump file.

erasure.note: dump_database writes every User row's email and full name to nightly_backup.json; the module sets BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS to 35 alongside a 03:00 cron string, and no code in the repository reads either constant.

stores.note: A JSON file written by dump_database holding the email and full name of every user row.

retention.criteria: rows whose deleted_at is older than the cutoff are deleted by purge_closed_accounts
